correctness.rationale: For all q>=2,n>=2 the word-append deletion-set decomposition proves B_2=binom(r,2)+k-t and the exact indicator representation. Independent uniform q-ary increments make change indicators iid Bernoulli((q-1)/q), and the ABA constraints on each eligible forest give a conditional binomial(Q,1/(q-1)) law. Orthogonal centered Bernoulli monomials prove the stated mean and polynomial variance. The standalone checker independently enumerated 17,337 q-ary words, validated exact conditional distributions for 1,338 transition-vector cases, and checked 72 additional parameters via exact rational calculations. All boundaries including n=2 and q=2 agree; finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: Exact variability of the number of distinct deletion outputs matters for local sphere packing, reconstruction and finite-block synchronization-code design. The new conditional law isolates genuinely nonbinary ABA-return randomness and yields a closed exact q-ary variance with n^3 scaling and alphabet-dependent coefficient. The result is a natural exact all-length extension, not an arbitrary finite table or reparameterized binary identity; no unsupported downstream theorem is claimed.
